headline: Colonial Push Breaks Nevish Stalemate as Kuura Strand Ignites
war_summary: Colonial arms have broken the deadlock in Nevish Line since the previous edition, pressing a 5–3 advantage after seven frantic base exchanges centered around Grief Mother and Blackcoat Way. Farther north, Kuura Strand has abruptly ignited into a furious contest, logging ten rapid base transitions within two hours that left one strongpoint reduced to no-man's-land and Warden forces clinging to five garrisons. In Viper Pit, an aggressive Colonial probe captured Blackthroat, establishing a fresh toehold as regional enlistments and casualties surged sharply. Warden defenders in Weathered Expanse managed to claw back a position to make the division two bases to seven, though punishing exchanges inflicted over eight hundred Warden casualties in the last two hours alone. In Callahan’s Passage, the guns have not slackened, devouring upwards of twenty-five hundred men in two hours without altering the 8–2 Warden balance. By contrast, the fierce storm over Palantine Berm has entirely subsided into silence, while escalating clashes across Mooring County and Stlican Shelf suggest heavy pressure mounting on neighboring perimeters.
